name: PaperPolyhedra
description: The main tool. Turns 3D polygon/prism specs into printable, foldable nets with tabs, flaps, lids, Kresling patterns and fiducial markers.

name: ScaffoldShell
description: PaperPolyhedra and FrustumSupport merged. The foldable shell plus the 3D-printed scaffold that goes inside it, sized from the shell rather than typed in. Exports PDF, SVG and OpenSCAD.

name: PaperPhicons
description: The voxel cutter. Generates cut files for physical icon blocks (cuboids) with ArUco markers for tracking.

name: DataPhysicalisation
description: Maps CSV columns onto physical dimensions (height, diameter, sides, colour), previews the result in 3D, and exports JSON that PaperPolyhedra imports.

name: PaperBlox
description: The first version of the system: an origami pattern that folds a box with an integrated ArUco marker.

name: FrustumSupport
description: Internal support-structure generator for frustum-shaped shells. Superseded by ScaffoldShell; kept until that has been validated against a printed frame.

name: WidgetGenerator
description: Shows what a widget will look like: a box with cut-outs in which smaller frustums move around.

name: Phicon Widgets
description: PaperPhicons blocks with cut-outs (squares, pills, circles) in the marker face, for tangible knobs, slots and buttons.
sourceNote: TEI27Software (local folder, not on GitHub): PaperPhicons_Boilerplate_v1_1_Cutout

name: Rounded Boxes
description: Boxes with a rounded-rectangle footprint: a rectangle with 45° chamfered corners, set by corner ratio and aspect.
sourceNote: TEI27Software (local folder, not on GitHub): dev_V9B_RH_v2_1a_RoundCorners

name: Oblique Boxes
description: Prisms and boxes whose top face is slid sideways, with an automatic limit that keeps the net foldable.
sourceNote: TEI27Software (local folder, not on GitHub): dev_V9B_RH_v2_3_ObliqueFrustums

name: Kresling Explorer
description: The folding behaviour of a Kresling cell: its energy curve against height and the geometry of one unit cell.
sourceNote: TEI27Software (local folder, not on GitHub): KreslingSim, KreslingVisGamma

name: Sliding Frustum Box
description: Up to four Phicons (frustums or Kresling cells) in one box, with their sliding range and cross-section at the ceiling.
sourceNote: TEI27Software (local folder, not on GitHub): SlidingFrustumBoxCP5

name: Phicon Playground
description: Try tangible Phicon widgets live: the webcam tracks printed markers and turns them into knobs, sliders, slots, dice and rotors.
sourceNote: TEI27Software (local folder, not on GitHub): PaperPhicon_AppBuilder_v2
